reason: Method is short-only on penny stock pumps/dumps with no concrete long-side rules provided.

setup.rule: Identify pump-and-dump scams via SEC filings showing promoters/insiders with cheap shares and hype (mailers/tweets/press releases)
setup.quote: when I say scam or pump, it's a question of why do all of these insiders or promoters have shares... And then they're sending out mailers or tweets... trying to get the stock price higher.

entry.rule: Short after manipulation peaks when signs of collapse appear
entry.quote: now I predominantly just short sell or bet against the scams and I try and be there the day of when it crashes 50-75%

exits.rule: Take 10-30% profit and move on; cut losses quickly
exits.quote: I try and take the meat of the move I try and make my 10 20 sometimes 30% and then I move on

ambiguities.issue: Mentions occasional long buys on non-scam momentum like Ebola thermometer stock but states predominant short-selling focus
ambiguities.assumption: Overall method treated as short-only per guidelines
